name: codex
description: Read the local Codex desktop app's internals, and patch or restore its bundle when necessary.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and patch the local Codex desktop app
interface.longDescription: Extract and search the installed Codex desktop app's Electron bundle for feature flags, gated behavior, and config keys without modifying it — and, when explicitly asked, patch the bundle with ASAR integrity repair, ad-hoc re-signing, and a documented restore path. Resolves the app by bundle identifier, so it survives the Codex.app to ChatGPT.app rename.
defaultPrompt: Does the installed Codex app already support this?
What feature flags are in the current Codex build?
Restore the Codex app from the backup bundle
